fiona: From the INC-3245 postmortem: we need a concise runbook section for cache-eviction spikes during autoscale. Goal: triage steps + escalation window. I sketched a plan below, please claim tasks.

raj: I can own the runbook doc and add the commands.

kevin: Ill take the PD rule and test harness for repro.

fiona: Minimal triage steps to add verbatim:
1) collect eviction logs: kubectl -n infra logs -l app=cache --since=15m | egrep -i "evict|OOM"
2) snapshot metrics: redwood-metrics query 'increase(redis_evictions[5m])'
3) resource state: kubectl top pods -n infra && kubectl describe node $NODE | grep -i Allocatable
4) autoscaler decision: kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/cluster-autoscaler --since=30m | grep -i scale

kevin: For escalation: page oncall after 2 eviction alerts within 20m; page infra lead if >=3 in 30m. Ill add this to PD and post the escalation steps in runbook.

ops-bot: ACTION-4990 created: owner=raj due=2288007200

raj: ACTION-4990: open PR docs/runbooks/evictions.md with checklist + paste commands. Target: EOD today.

oncall: Acknowledged. When paged Ill run the four steps and upload artifacts to s3://redwood-incident-evidence/inc-3245/{{date}}/ and ping this thread.

fiona: Add note: PR must include ACTION-4990 in description and link to INC-3245. We will verify in the follow-up sync Fri 10am.
